allocation_status: Teaching design;no official count in verified source.
rationale: Thirteen40minute lessons separate wave terms/equation/unit/boundary work,reflection and actual conditional echo,qualified sound refraction/diffraction and corner observation,environment/mitigation/road applications and independent final. Actual demonstrations/video/research need approved provision and remain unperformed if only supplied records used.
prerequisites: Graph axes,ratios,Hz/kHz/metre conversions and periodic motion.
Distinguish propagation,particle oscillation and actual from supplied evidence.
teacher_confirmation_required: Approve quiet safe echo/corner sites,moderate non-amplified sounds,clear routes,privacy and hearing/access needs. Stop unsuitable activity rather than increase noise.
Record actual roles/site/date/conditions and heard/not-heard outcomes;supplied records cannot certify outcome d demonstration.
No precise echo timing claim from ordinary reaction time;reverberation may not resolve an echo.
Provide/preview day/night refraction video if available;diagrams are not viewing evidence. Temperature/wind profiles,not clock time alone,govern inference.
Provide approved environment/application research sources and record actual navigation separately from print summaries.
No road/shoreline visits,traffic tests,lasers,loud sound or engineering activity. Local mitigation needs qualified evidence.
Confirm 40minute pacing,drawings/accessibility and source actual-activity opportunities.

lesson_map.title: Which graph gives which wave quantity?
What relationship does the wave equation express?
Can units check a wave calculation?
What changes across a stationary boundary?
What would demonstrate an echo safely?
How can a temperature gradient bend sound?
What does hearing around a corner establish?
How can different waves affect environments?
What makes a mitigation proposal defensible?
How can wave knowledge support road-use reasoning?
Can wave evidence support an independent application?
